items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: My wife, my present wife of 21 years now... Anyhow Sue is new to all of this

ctx.x: Did you ever have to do anything for living along the way besides playing drums?

Oh yes. But let me tell you, like okay. My wife, my present wife of 21 years now, had two children when we met. I had three. All boys. Five boys. And I’ll never forget — and most of the time I was on the road, that’s how I made my money. So as long as I was on the road all the time I could do okay. So I didn’t have any really ridiculous habits, I just sent my money home. And it worked out all right. Anyhow Sue is new to all of this, and she’s got the five boys, their ages of like at that time they were like 3 to…
